attempts_evidence.name: attempts_evidence
attempts_evidence.value: ("attempts"."source" = 'onchain_actor' AND "attempts"."tx_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "attempts"."log_index" IS NOT NULL) OR ("attempts"."source" = 'simulated' AND "attempts"."tx_hash" IS NULL)

mm_profiles_fmt.name: mm_profiles_fmt
mm_profiles_fmt.value:
"mm_profiles"."address" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{40}$' AND char_length("mm_profiles"."display_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 64
        AND char_length("mm_profiles"."bio") <= 1000 AND ("mm_profiles"."min_deal_usd" IS NULL OR "mm_profiles"."min_deal_usd" >= 0)
        AND cardinality("mm_profiles"."coverage") <= 10

proposals_fmt.name: proposals_fmt
proposals_fmt.value:
"proposals"."safe" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{40}$' AND "proposals"."issuer" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{40}$'
        AND "proposals"."mm" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{40}$' AND "proposals"."base" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{40}$'
        AND "proposals"."quote" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{40}$' AND "proposals"."terms_hash" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{64}$'
        AND ("proposals"."strategy_id" IS NULL OR "proposals"."strategy_id" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{64}$') AND char_length("proposals"."note") <= 1000
        AND "proposals"."kind" BETWEEN 0 AND 1

proposals_state.name: proposals_state
proposals_state.value:
("proposals"."status" <> 'accepted' OR "proposals"."mm_signature" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("proposals"."status" <> 'executed' OR ("proposals"."mm_signature" IS NOT NULL AND "proposals"."strategy_id" IS NOT NULL))
